question: Before changing a feature, the person wants to know what else the change touches — on the Sample board, changing F6 touches 1 feature and 6 workflow steps.

variants.a-panel: The answer is a section of the feature panel, under its dependencies; the canvas outlines the touched items in red.
variants.b-canvas: The canvas is the answer: everything the change does not touch fades, and a bar at the bottom says what is lit in one sentence.
variants.c-ask: A question box asked from the header in any view, answering as a list grouped by how directly each item is touched.
